Unlike the challenged Memory headline (r10 -0.13, val_state fading), Gold shows cohesion, trend-health, and no crowding caution. Given gate_helps is true, the trend discipline favors this leg; the lean is directional only and modest given the low track-record dir_accuracy.
evidence: gate_helps=true — absolute-trend gate validated as drawdown control
theses.dissent: Precious-metals miners carry idiosyncratic operational and gold-price beta; if the macro 'ai_tech' narrative keeps dominating headlines, gold miners may mean-revert despite clean trend texture, and the rank is a focus lens with ~0 forward IC.
